note: Every workflow a pull request can start belongs to exactly one category (tools/ci/workflows.test.js fails otherwise). npm run verify runs every category but integration; integration workflows reach live sources (ESPN, MLB Stats, the provider feeds) and run only with --include-live. Categories group the checks for people and for npm run verify:<alias>; they do not rename anything, so every check keeps the name branch protection may require.

live_jobs_note: Jobs that probe a live source from inside a deterministic workflow. npm run verify reports them NOT VERIFIED and runs them only with --include-live, as it does integration workflows; CI runs them as the workflow says. tools/ci/workflows.test.js checks every one names a real job.
